title.zh: 将巴西兰省伊莎贝拉市每年7月8日定为特别工作假日，以庆祝葡萄牙圣伊丽莎白瞻礼，并命名为伊莎贝拉欢乐节的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring July 8 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Isabela, Province of Basilan, in Celebration of the Feast of St. Elizabeth of Portugal, to Be Known as Fiesta Alegria De Isabela
title.orig: An Act Declaring July 8 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Isabela, Province of Basilan, in Celebration of the Feast of St. Elizabeth of Portugal, to Be Known as Fiesta Alegria De Isabela
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 8 tháng 7 hàng năm là ngày nghỉ làm việc đặc biệt tại Thành phố Isabela, Tỉnh Basilan, để kỷ niệm Lễ Thánh Elizabeth xứ Bồ Đào Nha, mang tên gọi là Lễ hội Vui vẻ Isabela
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้วันที่8กรกฎาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดทำงานพิเศษในนครอิซาเบลาจังหวัดบาซิลันเพื่อเฉลิมฉลองเทศกาลเซนต์เอลิซาเบ ธ แห่งโปรตุเกสซึ่งเรียกว่าเฟสตาอาเลเกรียเดอ อิซาเบลา
title.id: Undang-Undang Menetapkan 8 Juli Setiap Tahun sebagai Hari Libur Kerja Khusus di Kota Isabela, Provinsi Basilan, dalam Perayaan Pesta Santo Elizabeth dari Portugal, yang dikenal sebagai Fiesta Alegria De Isabela
title.ms: Akta Menetapkan 8 Julai Setiap Tahun sebagai Hari Cuti Bekerja Istimewa di Bandar Isabela, Wilayah Basilan, bagi Meraikan Hari Raya St. Elizabeth dari Portugal, yang dikenali sebagai Fiesta Alegria De Isabela

text.en: July 8 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the City of Isabela, Province of Basilan, in celebration of the feast of St. Elizabeth of Portugal, to be known as Fiesta Alegria de Isabela. Upon proclamation of the President, July8 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the said city.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
